Commentary.Commentary: The pitch seems to be a good one to bat on and that should keep Ireland in the contest. No doubts on the fact, that they would have to put up a really good show with the bat to pull off this chase. Can the Irishmen pull off something special? Join us in a while for the chase.

The debutant Barry McCarthy was the pick of the bowlers who did put up a very impressive show as he ended with superb figures of 4-0-33-4. All the other bowlers went for plenty and hardly troubled the Afghanistani batsmen who hammered them all over the park.

An enthralling batting performance by Afghanistan. After losing two wickets in the first three overs, Ireland were on top of the game with hardly any runs on the board. Najeeb Tarakai had different plans altogether as he first stitched a vital 54-run partnership with Samiullah Shenwari which set the platform for him to go hammer and tongs after it. The former also got to his maiden T20I fifty. Karim Janat and Mohammad Nabi chipped in with essential bits which ensured that the hosts post a total past the 180-run mark.

What happened there? It's a SIX! Shorter outside off, Zadran gets behind it and swings it over mid-wicket. There are two fielders getting across, from deep mid-wicket and square leg. The fielder from square leg goes out of the fence and pulls the ball back in play. Dockrell does not try to catch it as the fielder was already outside the ropes when threw the ball back in. The umpire refers it upstairs. Replays confirm it is a maximum. Afghanistan finish on 184/8!

OUT! Rashid run out! Shorter outside off, Rashid slams it through point. He wants the second but is sent back. The throw comes in at the non-strikers' end by Tucker and the bowler whips the bails off. He appeals and it is referred upstairs. Replays show that it is very close. When Rashid Khan got into his crease, the bails had just been dislodged. That is out. This has been a top over for Ireland. Amir Hamza walks out to bat.
The umpire has gone upstairs for a run-out appeal at the non-striker end.
Slower and fuller around off, Rashid sits low to slog it but gets an inside edge past his stumps towards the keeper. Vital dot ball.
Shorter outside off, dragged through mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Sprays it wide outside off, Zadran does not connect as it is too wide. The bowler is still on a hat-trick.
Rashid Khan walks out next. Hat-trick ball coming up...

OUT! Barry takes another one! Fuller outside off, Nabi looks to drag it over long off but does not connect well. The long off fielder, Tucker takes the catch and that is the end of Nabi. He played a handy cameo.
Najibullah Zadran is the next man in.

OUT! Tarakai missed out on his ton! Full and outside off, Tarakai goes for the slap over covers but gets a top edge. Paul Stirling gets under it and takes it at point. That ends a terrific knock by Najeeb Tarakai.
Barry McCarthy is back for his final over.
FOUR! Tonked! Too full on middle, Nabi gets under it and thumps it down the ground, over the head of the bowler for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, slapped hard through mid off for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Tarakai looks to flay it through but misses.
FOUR! Getting closer to the ton here! Low full toss outside off, Tarakai does not miss out and hammers it down the ground for a boundary. He moves on to 89!
Yorker outside off, Nabi swings it down the ground, through mid on for a single.
Fuller outside off, Tarakai slams it to long off for a single.
Stuart Thompson is back for a bowl.
FOUR! Carved! Full and wide outside off, Nabi reaches out for it and slices it over backward point for a boundary. Huge over for the hosts, 18 runs off it.
FOUR! Poor from Ireland! Waist high full toss, close to being a no ball. Nabi takes full toll and clobbers it through square leg for a boundary.
Goes round the wicket.
Length outside off, Nabi slams it down to long off for a brace.

SIX! Nabi shows his class! Low full toss outside off, Nabi gets under it and carves it  up and over extra cover for a maximum. That was a classical cricket shot, went all the way! 150 up for Afghanistan.
WIDE! Change of pace gone wrong, ends up spraying it way, wide outside off. A wide is signaled.
Fuller outside off, Tarakai drags it through mid on for a single.
Slower one, fuller outside off, Tarakai mistimes his jab back down to the bowler.
Kevin O'Brien is called back for a bowl.
SIX! Slapped! Shorter outside off, Nabi gets under it and dispatches it over mid-wicket for a maximum. That flew over the ropes.

Dropped! Fuller outside off, Tarakai looks to go over the leg side but gets a top edge. The keeper goes after it behind the wicket. He was never in control and spills the catch. Gary Wilson is not happy, so is the bowler.
FOUR! Too easy! Angling on a shorter length on the body, Tarakai pulls it down into the fine leg fence for a boundary. Can he get a ton here?
FOUR! In the gap! Shorter in length, angling on the stumps, Tarakai comes down the wicket and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Low full toss outside off, bunted down to long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, slower in pace, Nabi comes forward to drive but misses.
Barry McCarthy is back for a bowl.
Shorter outside off, dabbed towards short third man for a quick single.
Too full on off, Nabi can only jam it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Boom! Shorter outside off, Nabi does not miss out and slams it hard through covers for a boundary.
Tarakai swings this one down to long on for a single.
Floats it on off, Nabi presses forward and pushes it towards covers for a single.
Shorter outside off, placed towards point by Nabi. Tarakai wants the single but is sent back in time.
Jacob Mulder is back into the attack.
FOUR! Edged! Outside off on a good length, Tarakai goes for the pull but gets an outside edge down to third man for a boundary.
WIDE! Too full and outside off, left alone. Wide signaled.
Mohammad Nabi is the new man in.

OUT! Run out! Too full outside off, hit hard towards William Porterfield at extra cover. Tarakai wanted the single but not Janat. They go for it but the throw from the fielder is on target at the non-striker's end and Janat is caught way short of the crease.
Fuller outside off, swung down to long on for a single.
Too good! Full and wide outside off, carved to sweeper cover for a brace.
FOUR! Edged! Outside off on a length, Tarakai throws his bat at it. The ball flies off the outside edge down to the vacant third man region for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, Tarakai looks to flay it across but misses.
Stuart Thompson is back for a bowl.
Shorter outside off on a slower pace, Karim looks to upper cut it but misses.
Dropped! Fuller in length on the stumps, Janat looks to go over mid-wicket but fails to connect it well. Dockrell comes in from the deep, dives forward but spills the chance.
Mistimes this pull of a length ball towards mid on for a single.
Outside off, pushed towards covers where the captain misfields and allows a single. He wanted to throw the ball before even getting a grip of the ball.
Taps this one towards point and takes a quick single. There is a shy at the non-striker's end but the batsman had got in.
On a length outside off, Tarakai looks to pull but gets a bottom edge back towards the keeper.
Kevin O'Brien is back into the attack.
FOUR! Into the fence! Janat smashes this one through mid-wicket for a boundary. Good over for the hosts.
Tarakai turns this one through mid-wicket for a single.
Pushes this one towards covers for a single.
Shorter on the pads, tucked towards the on side.
SIX! The runs are flowing! Fired on the stumps, Karim slog sweeps this one over mid-wicket for another biggie. There have been a few of those coming. 100 up for Afghanistan!
Flatter down the leg side, nudged towards square leg for a single.
Shorter outside off, cuts it through point for a single.
Floats it on the stumps, driven again through mid off for a single.
Drives this full one through mid off for a single.
SIX! Smacked! Fuller on the stumps, Tarakai gets under this one and clobbers it over mid-wicket for another biggie. Clean hit, that!
Pushed through covers for a single by the batsman.
Maiden T20I fifty for Najeeb Tarakai.
FIFTY! Lands it outside off, allows it to spin and punches it through covers for a single. That brings up his fifty, he will want to make as many as possible from here on.
Shorter outside off, Karim looks to punch but gets it off the inner half, back down the wicket to the bowler.
Punches this short one through mid on for a single.
SIX! Going, going, gone! Floats it on the stumps, Tarakai gets under it and dispatches it over mid-wicket for a biggie. He has played some superb shots here.
Fires it on the pads, played down the ground through mid on for a single.
Another nudge towards the on side for a single.
Floats it on the stumps, turned through square leg for a single.
George Dockrell called back on for a burst.
Down the leg side, Tarakai clips it straight towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Fuller on the pads, Janat drives it towards long on for a single.
Wide outside off this time, Tarakai cuts it past point for a single.
Tarakai prods forward and defends it.
Tossed up outside off, Janat drives it down the ground towards long off for a single.
Karim Janat is the new man in. Afghanistan will want him to fire.

OUT! Cleaned up! Tossed up down the leg side, Shafiqullah shuffles and goes for the sweep but misses. He is gone a bit too across and he gets punished as he gets bowled around his legs. Change of ends works for Mulder. Shafiqullah has to depart for a golden duck.
Jacob Mulder has a change of ends.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Again down the leg side, Tarakai clips it fine down the leg side for a couple.
WIDE! Way down the leg side, Tarakai tries to clip it but misses. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Length delivery outside off, Tarakai drives it towards the fielder at mid off.
Shafiqullah Shafaq is the new man in.

OUT! Thompson strikes! Length delivery outside off, Shenwari goes for a slog but cannot make the desired contact. The ball flies off the top edge and balloons in the air. The keeper Gary Wilson calls for it and takes a fine catch towards gully. The Man of the Match in the last match has to walk back after getting off to a good start.
Angling into the stumps, Tarakai defends it on the off side with soft hands and runs a quick single.
50-run stand up between Tarakai and Shenwari!
FOUR! Width and punished! Good length delivery outside off, Tarakai slaps it through the cover-point region for a boundary. This partnership is looking dangerous.
Stuart Thompson returns for a bowl.
SIX! GONE THE DISTANCE! Floated outside off, Shenwari kneels down and slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket region for a biggie. That was powerfully hit.
Tossed up outside off, Shenwari camps back and pushes it towards mid off.
Angling into the pads, Shenwari tries to clip it but fails to make contact.
Way down the leg side, Shenwari goes for a sweep but misses. The ball raps him on his pads and the bowler appeals. The umpire is undisturbed as it was going down leg.
On the pads, Tarakai clips it on the leg side for a single.
Down the leg side, Shenwari clips it towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Too easy! Quicker one down the leg side, Tarakai guides it fine down the leg side for a single.
SIX! Short delivery in the line of the stumps, Tarakai uses his crease and pulls it with brute force. The ball sails over the ropes in the mid-wicket region for a maximum.
Down the leg side, Shenwari clips it through the square leg region for a single.
Short into the stumps, the batsman camps back and slaps it back to the bowler. Mulder cannot stop it and the batsmen run a single.
Full into the pads, Shenwari eases it down towards long on for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Tarakai camps back and punches it through covers for a single.
Jacob Mulder called on for a bowl.
Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Tarakai drives it down the ground to keep strike.
Leg bye! Down the leg side, Shenwari goes for the sweep but cannot connect. The ball hits him on his pads. A leg bye is taken.
A bit short into the pads, Tarakai flicks it through mid-wicket. A single is taken.
Full on the pads, Shenwari clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short into the pads, Tarakai camps back and pushes it towards long on for a single.
Tossed up down the leg side, Shenwari shuffles and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
George Dockrell is called in for a bowl.
Good length on off, played back to the bowler by Tarakai.
SIX! Timing! Too full and on the pads, Tarakai does not miss out and clips it over mid-wicket for a maximum. Superb shot, that!
Length ball outside off, Tarakai looks to go on the up through covers but finds the fielder at mid off.
Fuller on off, pushed towards cover-point for a quick single.
Fuller in length on off, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Lands it outside off, Tarakai comes forward and defends it.
Change of ends for Kevin O'Brien.
FOUR! In the gap! Fuller outside off, Tarakai gets behind it and crashes it wide of mid off for a boundary. 13 runs off the over.
Bowls it full and wide outside off, the batsman swings and misses.
Spears into the pads, worked through square leg for a single.
SIX! Fuller outside off, Tarakai gets under it and swings it high and handsome over long on. The ball flies over the fence, a fine catch on the grass banks.
Fuller in length on off, worked towards mid on by Shenwari for a single to get off the mark.
On a length outside off, pushed into covers by Shenwari. He looks for a single but is sent back.
WIDE! Sprays it wide outside off, Shenwari looks to go through the off side but misses.
Stuart Thompson is introduced into the attack.
Fuller in length on the stumps, played back to the bowler.

CHANCE! On a length outside off, Tarakai looks to drag it through the on side but gets it back down the wicket. The ball hits the timber at the non-striker's end but it did not touch the hand of the bowler who was diving to his right to stop it. Had he got a hand to it, he would have had a wicket as Shenwari didn't quite get back in the crease.
Good length around off, Tarakai stays back and punches it towards covers.
Samiullah Shenwari walks out to the middle.

OUT! Another one falls! Good length delivery outside off, the ball seems to be holding up, Stanikzai looks to go over long on but does not connect well. The fielder, Thompson gets to his left and takes a really good catch. Ireland are making early inroads.
Angles it on off, swung off the inner half through mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller length outside off, Tarakai heaves it off the inner half towards mid on from his crease.
Outside off on a length, pushed into covers by the captain of Afghanistan. They wanted the single but it is not given.
Shorter in length on the stumps, Stanikzai looks to pull but fails to put bat on ball.

Stanikzai is cramped for room as he gets this ball towards the on side. Tarakai wants the single but the bowler goes to his right, stops the ball, underarms a flick back towards the non-striker's end but misses.
Bowls it outside off, driven towards covers from the crease by Stanikzai.
On a length outside off, the batsman stays back and defends it.
FOUR! Up and over! Angling on a length on the stumps, Stanikzai comes down the wicket and slams it over the mid on region for a boundary. That was superbly hit.
Kevin O'Brien will share the new ball with Barry McCarthy.
Drags this one through mid-wicket for a couple.
WIDE! Outside off on a length outside off, left alone by the batsman.
Fuller on the stumps, Tarakai works it towards short fine leg from his crease.
Asghar Stanikzai is the new man in.

OUT! Big wicket for Ireland! Barry bowls it on a fuller length with a slight change of pace, Shahzad looks to clear the infield, giving himself room. He ends up scooping it to mid off where Kevin O'Brien goes to his left and pouches it safely. Ideal start for the visitors.
FOUR! Smacked! Length from McCarthy, Shahzad does not miss out and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. What a way to get off the mark.
Fuller outside off, Shahzad punches it on the up to the left of the bowler who stops the ball.
Good length outside off, Shahzad punches it towards point from his crease.
Right then, it's time for play! Mohammad Shahzad and Najeeb Tarakai are out to bat for Afghanistan. Ireland begin with Barry McCarthy. Here we go...
The players are out there maintaining a minute of silence for the attacks which took place at a hospital in Afghanistan.

Ireland captain, William Porterfield starts by saying that it does not matter if they lost the toss as the pitch won't change much. Admits that they were 15 runs short in the previous game. They are looking to improve in all departments. Hopes that they can contain the Afghanistan batsmen on this high scoring ground.
Afghanistan skipper, Asghar Stanikzai reckons that it is a good wicket to bat, they are looking to score in excess of 150. Calls it a good performance from Shahzad and Rashid in the last game.
TOSS - Afghanistan win the toss and opt to bat. Afghanistan remain unchanged while Ireland make a solitary change. Barry McCarthy comes in place for Craig Young.
Pitch Report - Ajay Mehra doing the report reckons that there are enough cracks on surface which should help the spinners. Batting first should be the way to go.

Hello and a warm welcome for the 2nd T20I between Afghanistan and Ireland in Greater Noida, India. Afghanistan have been on top of their game from a while and they continued their sheer dominance in the first match where they outplayed the visitors in all aspects of the game. They will want to continue their rich vein of form and seal the deal today itself. Ireland, on the other hand, will want to bounce back in this series and make it even with an all round performance. Expect a cracker! Stay tuned for the toss.
